goal: Complete all initial connections for private broadcasts even if the transaction returns early from peers
Prevent adversaries from exploiting a timing side channel to suppress connections and deanonymize nodes
agreement: Strong support with all correctness, interface, and memory concerns resolved (vasild, mzumsande)
Approach approval for using a fixed connection count and tracking disconnections directly (vasild)
Concept approval as a more streamlined design than existing alternatives (optout21)

categories.name: p2p
why: P1 because it closes a timing side channel that allows adversaries to deanonymize private broadcasts
Early return of a transaction could cancel outbound connections, leaking the transaction originator
